subject: humanities
notes: The Badshahi Mosque in Lahore, Pakistan, was built in 1671–1673 under the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb.
It is made of red sandstone decorated with white marble.
The mosque and its courtyard can hold about 100,000 worshippers.
The mosque stands across from the Lahore Fort.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the size of the Badshahi Mosque. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Badshahi Mosque and its courtyard can hold about 100,000 worshippers.
choices.B: The Badshahi Mosque was built in 1671–1673 under the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb.
choices.C: Made of red sandstone, the Badshahi Mosque is decorated with white marble.
choices.D: The Badshahi Mosque stands across from the Lahore Fort, in the city of Lahore, Pakistan.

explanation.why: Only one note tells the reader how big the mosque is: it and its courtyard can hold about 100,000 worshippers. A choice that emphasizes size must use that fact.
explanation.A: Correct. The number of worshippers the mosque can hold shows how large it is.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This gives the dates and the emperor, which tell when and under whom the mosque was built, not how big it is.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This describes the building materials, not the size.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This tells where the mosque stands but gives no sense of how large it is.
